description: This Java class models the '<key-map>' element used in entity relationship mappings within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides constructors for creating key map objects from parameters or XML elements, accessor methods, factory methods for generating lists of key maps, and methods for XML serialization, equality, hashing, and comparison.

classes.name: ModelKeyMap
classes.description: An immutable class representing a key mapping between entity fields in OFBiz, capable of being constructed from XML or parameters, with utility methods for list creation and XML conversion.
